spray_advisory: SUSPEND all foliar chemical and fertilizer spraying immediately. Rain wash-off will cause complete chemical wastage and potential groundwater runoff contamination.
field_operations: Ensure proper drainage channels in low-lying crop fields to prevent waterlogging. Delay harvesting of standing crops if feasible or move harvested produce to dry storage.
disease_alert: Post-rain high humidity triggers fungal spore germination (Blast, Phytophthora, Downy Mildew). Plan preventative systemic fungicide spray once leaf surfaces dry.

weather_condition: High Temperature Heatwave (> 38°C) with Low Humidity (< 35%)
spray_advisory: Do not apply chemical sprays during peak afternoon hours (11:00 AM - 4:00 PM). High temperature causes rapid droplet evaporation and severe chemical scorch / phytotoxicity on crop leaves. Spray only between 6:00-8:30 AM or 5:00-6:30 PM.
field_operations: Provide light, frequent evening irrigations. Apply straw mulch or biomass cover around vegetable root zones to retain soil moisture and reduce root zone heat stress.
disease_alert: Watch for rapid spider mite and whitefly population spikes under hot and dry conditions.

weather_condition: Overcast Sky, High Relative Humidity (> 85%) with Light Drizzle / Fog
spray_advisory: High disease risk window. Apply protective systemic fungicides (e.g., Mancozeb, Hexaconazole, Azoxystrobin) with a silicone-based non-ionic wetting sticker during non-rain intervals.
field_operations: Avoid excessive overhead sprinkler irrigation which increases canopy moisture duration.
disease_alert: High vulnerability window for Powdery Mildew, Late Blight in Tomato/Potato, and Rust in Wheat.

spray_advisory: PROHIBIT all pesticide spraying during gusty winds. Wind drift causes serious chemical loss, uneven coverage, and toxic drift hazards to neighboring fields and dwellings.
field_operations: Provide physical staking and earthing-up support for tall crops (Sugarcane, Banana, Maize, Tomato trellis). Check greenhouse / polyhouse plastic sheet anchoring.
disease_alert: Wind-borne spread of fungal urediniospores and bacterial droplets.
